action: Move the page 'Boiler' from Garden to Home.

before.title: Boiler is filed under Garden
before.body:
That page is about the flat's boiler, which the notes tie to Home, not to Garden.

Asked the team: Which of my places is the flat in? They said: Your flat notes, the boiler and the landlord, all sit under Home.

card.no: If you think of the boiler as part of the outside works, Garden is fine.
